text: BAM share rose 0.24 percentage points over 27 hours and 0.33 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 34.7% of Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee is the largest node at 22%, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The top-node lead has changed hands 71 times in this window, consistent with whale-driven routing rather than broad validator churn.
